div.div:
Steps
1. Front door
NGINX / Workhorse terminate TLS and Git HTTP.
2. Application
Rails / Puma — 60s ceiling; long work offloads.
3. Queue and SoR
Sidekiq / Redis then PostgreSQL.
4. Git RPC
Gitaly over gRPC — no shared NFS.
5. Job worker
Runner pulls jobs outbound; never inbound shell.
